evidence: Implemented internal/security/token/ package with Service (Issue, Validate, Refresh, Revoke, CleanExpired). HMAC-SHA256 signing, configurable TTL, deny-list revocation. 17 tests pass with race detector. golangci-lint clean.

Created handlers/auth.go with Login (bcrypt password validation + JWT issuance), Refresh (token rotation), Logout (token revocation). Added DashboardUserConfig to config schema. Rate-limited auth routes in router.go. 14 handler tests pass.
Port interface already exists at internal/domain/release/ports/event_store.go with EventStore interface (Append, LoadEvents, LoadEventsSince, LoadAllEvents). FileEventStore implements it.
Wired JWT validation into auth.go session mode. Auth middleware now accepts *token.Service, validates Bearer tokens, extracts claims to AuthenticatedUser. 4 new session auth tests pass.

Added 20 unit tests for auth handlers (Login, Refresh, Logout with all error paths) and 8 integration tests (full login/refresh/logout flows, revoked token rejection, role mapping, unauthenticated endpoints). Coverage: auth handlers 91-100%, middleware auth 100%, token service 89.4%, router 100%. All tests pass with race detector, lint clean.
